nodes.title: MV递归提示词
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the primary visual reference for the scene, composition, body, clothing, and starting viewpoint.

<Picture 2> shows the same male singer as <Picture 1> from the front. Use <Picture 2> only to preserve his facial identity, facial structure, and appearance when his face becomes more visible. Do not introduce it as a second person, duplicate the singer, copy its background, or force the singer to remain front-facing.

summary:
[reference generation, audio reuse] A continuous audio-driven performance preserving the referenced subject and visual style.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: fully_preserved - Identity, appearance, clothing, and essential visual attributes are preserved.
<Picture 2>: fully_preserved - Identity, appearance, clothing, and essential visual attributes are preserved.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - The supplied audio segment is the authoritative timing and performance source.

detailed_description:
Cinematic Drama
[Shot 1] One uninterrupted continuous shot of the male singer from <Picture 1>, with his identity and facial details additionally referenced from <Picture 2>. The subject’s facial expression, lip movement, body motion, rhythm, intensity, and natural pauses respond closely to <Audio 1>. Preserve the scene, clothing, composition, and visual continuity of <Picture 1>. When the singer naturally turns toward the camera, maintain the facial identity shown in <Picture 2>. Maintain continuous behavior without restarting the performance, reintroducing the subject, cutting to a new viewpoint, forcing a new opening pose, or imposing a scripted ending.

overall_soundscape:
<Audio 1> is the authoritative soundtrack and timing source. Do not introduce additional dialogue or conflicting sound events.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
